models.title: Reading · Five generations share the same birthday

block.label: READING · FIVE GENERATIONS SHARE THE SAME BIRTHDAY
block.html:
A family in the United States has entered the Guinness World Records after five generations were born on the same day of the year. The family members all share September 14 as their birthday. The record was officially confirmed after the birth of Arthur Bell in Omaha in 2025.

The story began in 1907, when Wilber Harlow was born. His descendant Addie Harlow was born in 1949, followed by Donald Harlow in 1972 and Emma Bell in 1997. Finally, Arthur Bell was born in 2025. This means that the same date appears across 118 years of family history.

The family’s situation is extremely unusual. The Guinness World Records had previously registered cases involving four generations sharing the same birthday, but this family became the first to have five generations in a direct line of descent born on the same date.

Adapted from CNN Brasil.
